description: Sync the Loom videos whose share links you list, one searchable document per video with its transcript.
opening: Sync the Loom videos whose share links you list. Each video is one document with its title, owner, description and transcript. Discord and Microsoft Teams messages that link to a listed video connect to it in the graph.

No Loom account or token is needed, and only the videos you list are synced: there is no workspace-wide listing. Loom permissions are not imported, so once a password-protected video is synced, its transcript is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Removing a link from the list does not remove the video from HydraDB, and a video deleted in Loom can stay searchable.

connect.auth: Loom needs no API key or sign-in. You list the share links of the videos to sync. A password-protected video also needs its share password.

credentials.name: video_urls
credentials.text: The share or embed links of the videos to sync.

credentials.name: password
credentials.text: A share password used for every protected video that has no password of its own in `video_passwords`.

credentials.name: video_passwords
credentials.text: Share passwords for individual videos, as a JSON object keyed by the 32-character video id.

steps.title: Copy the share links
steps.text: Copy the share link of each Loom video to sync. For a password-protected video, note its share password.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Add the links as `video_urls`. For protected videos, add `password`, or `video_passwords` to give each video its own password.

steps.title: Select videos
steps.text: HydraDB lists one item per link and tries to read each video's title. A link it cannot read as a Loom link fails this step. A video that is missing or private is still listed, with a placeholder title, and can fail or be skipped when it syncs. Select the videos to sync.

connect.account: One connector reads the videos you list. There is no Loom account behind it. To add a video later, add its share link.

sync.first_sync: Syncs every listed video, whatever its age.
sync.changes: Each sync reads every listed video again. Only videos whose content changed are updated.
sync.edits: An edited title, description or transcript is picked up on the next sync.
sync.deletes: Removing a link, or a video that can no longer be read, does not remove its document. A video deleted in Loom can stay searchable in HydraDB.
notes: If a video's transcript cannot be read, the video is skipped for that sync, so the transcript already in HydraDB is kept.
If the password is rejected for every selected video, the sync fails.

documents.name: Videos
documents.one_document: One listed Loom video with its transcript. A video with no title, owner, description or transcript is skipped.
documents.title: The video title, or `Loom video <id>` when it has none.
documents.text: The title, an `Owner` line, the description when it differs from the title, then the transcript. The transcript has a `Transcript` heading when other text comes before it. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the video was last updated, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: The video's share link on loom.com.
documents.files: None. The video file is not downloaded.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.text: The owner's display name, written as the `Owner` line. The owner is not attached to the video as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: description
attributes.text: The owner's description of the video, written after the `Owner` line.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the video was last updated, written as an `Updated` line. Sets the result date.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the video was created. Sets the result date only when there is no update time. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.loom_video_id
attributes.text: The 32-character video id. Picks out one video. Discord and Microsoft Teams messages that link to the video connect to it by this id. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.owner_name
attributes.text: The owner's display name. Limits a query to one owner's videos. Not searchable under this key: the same name is searchable through the `Owner` line.

attributes.name: connector_id
attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's videos. Not searchable.

example_searches: What does the onboarding walkthrough video say about setting up SSO?
Which Discord messages linked to the product demo Loom?
What did Alex explain in the Q3 roadmap video?

connections: A Discord or Microsoft Teams message to each listed Loom video it links to, by share or embed link, up to 50 videos per message.
The message connects to the video once the video is synced into the same collection as the message. Until then, it points to a placeholder.
Videos have no links of their own to other items.
graph.people: The connector does not attach the owner to a video as a person. The owner's name is part of the video text.
graph.from_text: The title, owner, description and transcript.

not_synced: Videos whose share links you did not list.
Video and audio files, comments, reactions and view counts.
Removals: a link removed from the list stays in HydraDB, and a video deleted in Loom can stay.
